title: Sig-DEG for Distillation: Making Diffusion Models Faster and Lighter
abstract: arXiv:2508.16939v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art generative performance but remain computationally expensive at inference, often requiring many discretization steps. We propose Sig-DEG (Signature-based Differential Equation Generator), a generator for distilling pre-trained diffusion models. Inspired by high-order stochastic Taylor expansions, Sig-DEG combines partial signatures that summarize Brownian motion over subintervals with a recurrent structure to approximate stochastic differential equation solutions to achieve universality. We formulate distillation as supervised learning, matching fine-resolution teacher trajectories on a coarse time grid. At inference, Sig-DEG enables fast generation, as the partial signatures can be simulated exactly from their known distributions without requiring fine-grained Brownian paths. Experiments on image and time-series generation demonstrate competitive sample quality with inference speedups of up t

translated_title: Sig-DEG用于蒸馏：让扩散模型更快更轻量
translated_abstract: 扩散模型实现了最先进的生成性能，但在推理阶段的计算成本依然高昂，通常需要大量的离散化步骤。我们提出了Sig-DEG（基于签名的微分方程生成器），一种用于蒸馏预训练扩散模型的生成器。受高阶随机泰勒展开的启发，Sig-DEG将总结子区间上布朗运动信息的部分签名与循环结构相结合，以逼近随机微分方程的解，从而实现通用性。我们将蒸馏问题表述为监督学习，在粗时间网格上匹配细分辨率的教师轨迹。在推理阶段，Sig-DEG能够实现快速生成，因为部分签名可以从其已知分布中被精确模拟，无需细粒度的布朗路径。在图像和时间序列生成任务上的实验表明，该方法在样本质量具有竞争力的同时，推理速度可大幅提升。
tldr: 本文提出Sig-DEG，利用部分签名与循环结构逼近随机微分方程的解来蒸馏预训练扩散模型，在保持有竞争力的样本质量的同时显著提升推理速度。
en_tdlr: Sig-DEG distills pre-trained diffusion models by combining partial signatures of Brownian motion with a recurrent structure to approximate SDE solutions, achieving competitive sample quality with significantly faster inference.
